summary: The RptMnuPlcSch_PlcSchedule is a user control class for handling a report menu related to placement schedules in a web application. It provides various user interface controls and workflows to manage how placement schedule reports are generated and displayed.
purpose: The purpose of this control is to allow users, likely administrators or coordinators, to generate reports on placement schedules with various customization options including filtering, sorting, and output format selection.

workflows.name: Report Generation
steps: User selects department, program, and term.
User sets report options like sorting and inclusion of student and schedule details.
User selects output format for the report (e.g., single PDF, with or without page breaks, or individual PDF files).
User clicks the 'Run Report' button to generate the report.

business_rules: Only confirmed requests can be included in the report or include accepted ones as specified by the user.
The report can be sorted by instructor or destination.
validations: Custom validator ensures that generated reports do not exceed a maximum number of items.
JavaScript variables facilitate client-side validations and dynamic content management.
conditions: If 'radConfirmedRequestsOnly' is checked, only confirmed requests will be included.
If 'radAcceptedConfirmedRequests' is checked, both accepted and confirmed requests will be included.
If 'radALLRequestsExceptDecl' is checked, all requests except declined or canceled will be included.
system_behavior: Fills dropdowns for department, program, and term based on user session settings.
Binds data to controls dynamically on page load and pre-render events.
